facts.en: Completed a BA in Public Administration at Fictional Institute D049 in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构院校 D049 完成公共行政文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a municipal facilities programme assistant at Fictional Agency D049 from 2019-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2019-06 至 2026-08 在虚构机构 D049 担任市政设施项目助理。

facts.en: Maintained meeting and submission schedules for building-efficiency retrofit proposals; engineers produced the technical assessments.
facts.zh: 维护建筑节能改造提案的会议及提交时间表；工程师编制技术评估。

facts.en: Used spreadsheets to log document versions, approval owners and outstanding actions.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格记录文件版本、审批负责人及待办行动。

facts.en: Worked with an engineer and administrator to consolidate evidence folders for 7 retrofit proposals during 2025-03 to 2025-06.
facts.zh: 在 2025-03 至 2025-06 与工程师及行政员合作，为 7 份改造提案整合证据文件夹。

facts.en: Across those 7 proposal packs, missing mandatory attachments at internal review fell from 19 in first drafts to 4 at final review; this reflects document completeness, not energy savings.
facts.zh: 在这 7 份提案资料中，内部审核发现的必需附件缺失从初稿的 19 项降至终审的 4 项；这反映文件完整性，而非节能量。

facts.en: Prepared plain-language meeting summaries for facilities managers using engineer-approved technical wording.
facts.zh: 使用工程师批准的技术措辞，为设施经理准备通俗会议摘要。

facts.en: Completed a 2026-02 self-directed spreadsheet exercise comparing fictional lighting options using supplied consumption assumptions.
facts.zh: 2026-02 完成自主电子表格练习，使用给定能耗假设比较虚构照明方案。

facts.en: The exercise was not a measured building audit and was not used to approve a retrofit.
facts.zh: 该练习并非实测建筑审计，也未用于批准改造。

facts.en: Drafted a community consultation schedule for 2026-05; the consultation was postponed and no sessions were delivered.
facts.zh: 为 2026-05 起草社区咨询时间表；咨询延期，未开展任何场次。

facts.en: Supported a peak of 9 proposal files in 2025-10; the regular allocation in 2026-08 was 4.
facts.zh: 2025-10 高峰期支持 9 份提案档案；2026-08 常规分工为 4 份。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Reuse Network V049 during evenings from 2024-01 to 2024-09 while employed, arranging repair-session bookings.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2024-09 任职期间，晚间在虚构再利用网络 V049 志愿安排维修活动预约。

facts.en: Made a personal photo catalog of neighborhood doors; it was not a heritage survey or environmental dataset.
facts.zh: 制作个人社区门扉照片目录；并非遗产调查或环境数据集。

facts.en: Applied access controls to draft project documents and maintained a record of authorized recipients.
facts.zh: 为项目草稿文件应用访问控制，并维护授权接收者记录。

facts.en: No environmental permitting authority, emissions-accounting qualification or field-sampling experience is claimed.
facts.zh: 不声称拥有环境许可审批权限、排放核算资格或现场采样经验。

facts.en: A slide draft attributes 25% energy reduction to the proposals, but the source contains forecast scenarios rather than post-installation readings.
facts.zh: 一份幻灯片草稿将 25% 能耗降低归于这些提案，但来源包含预测情景而非安装后读数。

facts.en: An informal project list names the candidate as consultation lead, while the staffing sheet names an engagement officer and lists the candidate as scheduling support.
facts.zh: 非正式项目清单将候选人列为咨询负责人，而人员表列一位参与事务专员为负责人，候选人为排期支持。

facts.en: Budget changes and procurement commitments required programme-manager approval; the candidate prepared supporting papers only.
facts.zh: 预算变更及采购承诺需项目经理审批；候选人仅准备支持文件。
